feeds.title: Mom 2.0
feeds.description: Mom 2.0 is a gathering of influencers and leaders who create content online and on-air in parenting, entertainment, food, politics, business, marketing, technology, social change, travel, and design. Follow to get the latest updates.

feeds.title: The Simple Parent
feeds.description: My name is Mariah & I'm the mom of two. Also a baseball mom & dance mom. We're a multi-generational family and making life work. With our busy lives, I aim to share easy ideas for simple parenting and personal stories, ideas for easy family fun, recipes, and crafts! Subscribe the blog to get the latest tips, articles, and more!

feeds.title: Jill B Jarvis
feeds.description: Welcome to BigKidSmallCity. I'm Jill. My kids aren't really big, and Houston isn't small, but my kids FEEL big while we are exploring this big city one small piece at a time. It is my mission to encourage parents of young kids to do get out of the house, rejoin the human race an enjoy life more than you ever thought possible. BigKidSmallCity is the go-to blog for things to do in Houston with kids!

feeds.title: Inspiring Momma
feeds.description: I am Heather Brummett. I'm just a real mom, sharing my real-life experiences with the world. The site is all about inspiring mommas everywhere! You'll love the recipes, crafts, travel ideas, weight loss, and encouragement we share.

feeds.title: Veronika's Blushing
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Veronika! Wife to Kevin and mama to Harper and Lincoln! This is a space where I share outfits, beauty faves, home decor, family life & much more.

feeds.title: Simply Clarke Blog
feeds.description: Marquis Clarke is a lifestyle blogger from the Houston, Texas area. She is a modern mom of two, who blogs about marriage, faith, fashion, and parenting. She seeks to encourage women in their journey through this breathtakingly beautiful life.

feeds.title: The Soccer Mom Blog
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Stacey - mom of 2, positive thinker & coffee drinker! I created this site to be a positive resource for moms and families. Follow me for fun, DO-able ideas, and inspiration for the modern wife and mama and know more about parenting & positive lifestyle for moms.

feeds.title: Meg O. on the Go
feeds.description: Houston blogger Meg O. on the Go shares all things beauty, motherhood, and lifestyle for the busy woman or mom. She's famous for her makeup dupes posts and keeps it real with motherhood.

feeds.title: Greater Houston Moms
feeds.description: Greater Houston Moms is online neighborhood for things to do in Houston for Kids & Families - with a particular emphasis on supporting Moms!

feeds.title: It's Not Hou It's Me
feeds.description: It's Not Hou It's Me is an indispensable resource for Houston residents to learn about the hippest places in town. From trending restaurants and new fitness studios to cultural events and art installations, we provide inside tips for readers to fall in love with their hometown!

feeds.title: My Red Glasses
feeds.description: My Red Glasses is a fashion and lifestyle website, featuring the latest in fashion, interiors, dining, health, and fitness. Roz Pactor the author of the blog is a fashion and marketing consultant and fashion or lifestyle blogger. She and her team create, curate, and present elegant pieces of upscale fashion literature from a closer perspective and offer tips and recommendations. Explore more through her blog.

feeds.title: Mommy Poppins Houston
feeds.description: This segment from Mommy Poppins lists all the fun activities to do, places to visit, and Enjoy with your kids in the fun and vibrant city of Houston. Explore curated Guides, Family travel spots, Personal experiences, and more. Mommy Poppins is a family activity website that helps people find things to do with kids.

feeds.title: The House of Fancy
feeds.description: Binge on the Top articles sharing Blogging Tips, Lifestyle & Travel Content from houseoffancy.com. The House of Fancy is the lifestyle brand created by wife, mom, blogger, fashionista, foodie, home project addict, wine enthusiast, entertainer, and sometimes DIY Queen, Ashley Lastovica (formerly Fancy Ashley).

feeds.title: Honey We're Home
feeds.description: Honey We're Home is a lifestyle blog where Megan shares her passion for style, home decor, organization and fitness, with a good bit of family life and baby tips in there. Find blogs on organizing your home.

feeds.title: Janelle Rendon
feeds.description: Janelle Rendon is a wife, mother of three, and Houston-based lifestyle blogger. In her blog, she writes articles and shares her favorite things she purchases on Amazon, affordable fashion and home find, fun things to do/places to go with your kids, and some general inspiration and good vibes along the way.

feeds.title: Lux Mommy Blog
feeds.description: My name is Amanda, and I am currently living in Houston, TX with my family. I've lived in Texas my whole life. I am originally from a small beach community, but moved to Houston to attend University of Houston and have been here ever since. Growing up it was clear that I had an eye for fashion which only grew over time. It was finally time for me to create an outlet for that passion, and LuxMommy was born.

feeds.title: A Beautiful RAWR » Fashion
feeds.description: Dive into her blog and learn more about fashion, style, the latest trends, tips, categories, products, and more. A Beautiful RAWR blog is owned and managed by Linh, wife, and girl mom. This blog is her creative space to document, share, and connect with other women like herself who love fashion, faith, fitness, and family.

feeds.title: The Snazzy Mom
feeds.description: Arushi is a happily married full-time working boy mom based in Houston, Texas. The Snazzy Mom blog provides readers with knowledge gleaned through her experiences, ideas, and recommendations to stay stylish, have fun, and live life to the fullest as a mom. She shares all things she loves: fashion, lifestyle, fitness, family adventures, and of course all things on motherhood. Follow her to get the latest updates.

feeds.title: The Ashmores Blog
feeds.description: Hey!! My name is Brittany, mom to 3 children, and married to my college sweetheart! I love sharing my heart for Jesus and building a community! Welcome to blog, Follow for more updates.

feeds.title: Moms Without Answers
feeds.description: I love sharing all things mom life-related including recipes, DIY's, real mom talk, crafts and more! I'm Channing. I am mom to 3 amazing girls and wife to my fire-fighting hubby, Eric.

feeds.title: Snapshots & My Thoughts
feeds.description: Snapshots & My Thoughts is a lifestyle blog featuring articles on my daily life, family, food recipes, decor and travel. I'm a Houston-based photographer and blogger who is married to my best friend, Sasha, and a mama to four sweet little ladies.

feeds.title: Haute & Humid
feeds.description: Haute and Humid is a fashion and lifestyle blog with a spotlight on making your everyday life effortless, attainable and fun. Hi! I'm Sara and welcome to Haute and Humid. I am a wife and mom of two, residing in the great state of Texas.

feeds.title: HTX MOM Blog
feeds.description: Hey there! I'm Kim, and this is my little space to write my thoughts and share my journey going from Corporate America to entrepreneurship. I hope to share some inspiration for those moms slogging it out as a working mom and keep you all posted on my journey to starting my own business. Don't miss any updates and stay informed on crucial teams.

feeds.title: Not Your Mom Blog
feeds.description: Sharon Rose Mayes is a PR-friendly blogger near Houston, Texas. Her blog Not Your Mom provides critical wisdom and insights on many Motherhood, Lifestyle, and Health topics. Explore what Sharon writes about her life, playing professional gaming and so much more.

feeds.title: One Fly Mama
feeds.description: I'm Jasmine. Welcome to my blog! Here, you'll find all things faith, family, travel, and parties. I love DIY projects, celebrating holidays, decorating, delicious food, and a good drink from time to time, so you'll most certainly find me sharing those things as well.

feeds.title: The Mom Life Blog
feeds.description: The Mom Life is a resource blog by Dhee, a travel content creator. Join her on the adventures of motherhood as she shares with you some parenting tips, mommy advice, product reviews, frugal shopping, hauls, meal ideas, must-haves, travels, and a lot more real-mom life stories.

feeds.title: Moms Confession
feeds.description: The busy moms' resource for simple recipes, meal planning, organization tips and life hacks. From pregnant moms to empty nesters and everything in between, Moms Confession is a place for fellow busy moms to easily find tips and tricks to manage their lives more efficiently.

feeds.title: Lipstick & Brunch Blog
feeds.description: My name is Nicole. I was born and raised in Honduras and moved to Texas at the age of 24. I'm a mom, wife and I love sharing my fitness journey, life with Type I Diabetes, food, beauty and my lifestyle in Houston and Sugar Land, Texas.

feeds.title: West University Moms Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I am Amanda. As a mother of two, it didn't take long to see that Houston is a mom (and dad's) dream. Whether it's one of the many museums, parks, activities, restaurants or festival the opportunities are endless. I have cumulated local resources, activities, and articles that I hope you find useful. Fellow mamas, please enjoy this site and I welcome your feedback and contributions!

feeds.title: South Houston Moms Blog
feeds.description: The South Houston Moms is the first of its kind site which focuses on everything Friendswood, Pearland, Sugar Land and the surrounding area. We want to provide a one-stop-shop to anything a Mom needs and wants from local nail salons to recommended pediatricians to kid-friendly birthday locations to a handyman or painter. We've gathered tons of resources for you to have at your fingertips, and continue to add to our list all the time.

feeds.title: Momma of Dos
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Connie Leon. I am Lifestyle and Parenting Blogger. Momma of Dos, this blog has developed into a lifestyle and parenting space that allows me to share my creativity, my experiences as a Momma, my suggestions and advice and to connect to so many people of all walks of life. Follow this blog to learn more about lifestyle and parenting.

feeds.title: Hello Honey Blog
feeds.description: Sharing sales, home decor, family fun, and lots of shoes, mom-hood, & life along the way. Brittany is a mom of 2 as well as a blogger and stylist.

feeds.title: C.Style
feeds.description: Fashion blog that makes style fun and accessible to everyone, while passing along style tips and tricks. I started a styling business and blog as an outlet, and both proved to be more rewarding than I ever imagined. I didn't realize how therapeutic it would be and how much growth I would experience through sharing not only style, but my messy life struggles with you all.

feeds.title: Motherhood Center Blog
feeds.description: One of the most comprehensive Pregnancy & Parenting blogs in Houston, here you will find exceptional and in-depth medical guidance, tips, and support on Pregnancy, Postpartum, and Motherhood. The Motherhood Center is a pregnancy wellness, education, and in-home care service provider focused on education.
